segments.ja492:1.3: Anvesaṃ vicariṃ [vipule (syā. ka.)] ñātī, teme adhigatā mayā.
segments.ja492:2.3: Rammā cimā girīnajjo [girinadiyo (sī. pī.)], phāsuvāso bhavissati.
segments.ja492:4.1: Aññampi [aññaṃ hi (sī. pī.)] leṇaṃ pariyesa, sattu no idha vijjati;
segments.ja492:4.3: So taccha sūkare hanti, idhāgantvā varaṃ varaṃ.
segments.ja492:5.1: Ko numhākaṃ [ko namhākaṃ (sī. pī.)] idha sattu, ko ñātī susamāgate;
segments.ja492:5.3: Duppadhaṃse [appadhaṃse (sī. pī.)] padhaṃseti, taṃ me akkhātha pucchitā.
segments.ja492:6.3: So taccha sūkare hanti, idhāgantvā varaṃ varaṃ.
segments.ja492:7.1: Na no dāṭhā na vijjanti [nu vijjanti (ka.)], balaṃ kāye samohitaṃ;
segments.ja492:7.3: Sabbe samaggā hutvāna, vasaṃ kāhāma ekakaṃ.
segments.ja492:8.3: Yopi yuddhe palāyeyya, tampi pacchā hanāmase.
segments.ja492:9.1: Pāṇātipātā virato nu ajja, abhayaṃ nu te sabbabhūtesu dinnaṃ;
segments.ja492:9.3: Dāṭhā nu te migavadhāya [miga viriyaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] na santi, yo saṅghapatto kapaṇova jhāyasi.
segments.ja492:10.1: Na me dāṭhā na vijjanti, balaṃ kāye samohitaṃ;
segments.ja492:10.3: Ñātī ca disvāna sāmaggī ekato, tasmā ca jhāyāmi vanamhi ekako.
segments.ja492:11.1: Imassudaṃ yanti disodisaṃ pure, bhayaṭṭitā leṇagavesino puthu;
segments.ja492:11.3: Te dāni saṅgamma vasanti ekato, yatthaṭṭhitā duppasahajja te mayā.
segments.ja492:12.3: Te maṃ samaggā hiṃseyyuṃ, tasmā nesaṃ na patthaye [apatthave (pī.)].
segments.ja492:13.1: Ekova indo asure jināti, ekova seno hanti dije pasayha;
segments.ja492:13.3: Ekova byaggho migasaṅghapatto, varaṃ varaṃ hanti balañhi tādisaṃ.
segments.ja492:14.1: Na heva indo na seno, napi byaggho migādhipo;
segments.ja492:14.3: Samagge sahite ñātī, na byagghe [byagghe ca (sī. pī.), byaggho na (syā.)] kurute vase.
segments.ja492:16.3: Tañca seno nitāḷeti, veyyagghiyeva sā gati.
segments.ja492:17.3: Dāṭhī dāṭhīsu pakkhandi, maññamāno yathā pure.
segments.ja492:18.1: Sādhu sambahulā ñātī, api rukkhā araññajā;
